plugins.name: project-scaffold
plugins.description: Scaffold a new project from composable copier layers. Runs the six-question interview, derives the rest from rules/choices.md, picks a profile, runs its generator, renders the layer set in order, and reports every file written and every command that failed.

plugins.name: project-scaffold-update
plugins.description: Change a repository that already exists: adopt a layer it does not have, re-render a layer whose template moved, or retrofit onto a repository that predates this tool. copier update does not work here, since a layer rendered from a local path records no _commit, so the method is re-render plus git diff.
